dedupe_keys.name: giga maps open global map of schools and their connectivity

description: Giga is a partnership between UNICEF and the International Telecommunication Union, established in 2019, that helps governments connect every school to the internet and develops open-source solutions for school connectivity. Its Giga Maps service is described as an open and live global map of schools and their connectivity, used to identify schools and monitor their connectivity in real time; the programme's other pillars model the infrastructure and investment needed, mobilise finance and support contracting, with capacity development for countries. Coverage: schools in the countries Giga works with, worldwide. Access: the Giga Maps web application and the programme site. Licence: not stated on the pages read; free to view. Caveats: the map application loads its content dynamically, so school counts, data sources and download terms could not be read on the day. Simulation uses are school locations for hazard exposure and school connectivity as an indicator for emergency communication planning. Related records: the NCES school locations, GIAS and ODEF school registers.
